svg.title: InnerAura
svg.desc: InnerAura footer, mutation three: the filled bands collapse to hairline contours drawn by a comb of alpha thresholds, three phase-shifted line sets cross-fade so the contours migrate, and the wordmark keeps the filled shelf palette as the only mass on the sheet.

hw:chromatic.theory: level-set line work — area collapsed to contour, palette withdrawn to the figure

hw:material.surface: quantized terrain under an ordered screen

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Collapse area into line. The field stops being filled bands and becomes a surveyor's contour plot, leaving the wordmark as the only mass on the sheet.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: The LUT is replaced by a comb. After the same stretch the height is moved into alpha with luminanceToAlpha, then a thirty-entry discrete alpha table with a one at every fifth entry cuts the terrain into six thin rings while the colour channels are flooded flat — so the lines are the level sets themselves rather than an outline drawn around them, and they crowd where the ground is steep and open where it is flat, exactly as contours behave. That also delivers the contour migration declined earlier for cost: three otherwise identical line sets are offset by a ninetieth of the range and cross-faded on staggered opacity delays over 26.18 seconds, so each set fades up as its neighbour fades down and the lines step outward without a single filter attribute animating. The wordmark keeps mutation two's shallow-shelf palette and its 45-degree screen, so the mass that was the sea floor in the parent becomes the only solid object here — figure and ground swing back, but the word carries its inherited chromatics forward. A far contour set on the second seed sits at 0.20 as a survey underlay.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Cross-fading three phase-shifted sets means at the mid-point of every transition two line sets are visible at once, so the contours briefly double before resolving — read as a drafting shimmer here, but it is a real artefact of the technique and not a drawn effect. Line weight is not directly controllable: it falls out of the one-in-five alpha comb and the local terrain gradient, so contours are hairline on steep ground and can bloom to several pixels where the ground is nearly flat, which no parameter in the file will even out. Collapsing to line drops most of the palette — only cobalt and its derived mid shade survive in the field, and mint, chartreuse and orchid now exist solely inside the wordmark, which is the furthest any mutation in this run travels from the supplied DNA. Six thin rings over a 4px screen is close to the resolution floor; below full width the lines will drop out before the dots do.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: Canvas and wordmark geometry unchanged. Contour comb: 30 discrete alpha entries, a one every fifth, giving six rings per range. Phase offsets of one and two ninetieths of the range on the second and third sets, cross-faded at 26.18s with delays of -8.727 and -17.453 so the three are evenly spaced across the cycle. Far contour underlay on seed 331 with 24 entries every eighth at 0.20. Wordmark on the shelf LUT at intercept -0.300 with the 45-degree screen inherited.
